reservations.numberFormatHint: How new reservation numbers are generated. Numbering is per-organization and starts at 1.
reservations.resetYearlyHint: When on, the year is included and the sequence restarts every year (RES-2026-00001). When off, numbering is continuous (RES-00001).

payments.overpaymentHint: What happens when a recorded payment is larger than the outstanding balance.

cashier.title: Cashier Daybook
cashier.subtitle: The day's cash position for a building — opening, movements, closing.
cashier.noDrawerNotice: No cash drawer exists for this building yet. It will be created automatically on the first cash movement; set its opening float in Settings → Bank Accounts.
cashier.daybookSubtitle: Debit = cash in · Credit = cash out. Non-cash collections are shown with no effect on the cash balance.
cashier.lockSubtitle: Count the drawer and compare it to the closing balance. Locking freezes the day; any variance posts an adjustment.
cashier.varianceWillAdjust: The variance will be posted as a drawer adjustment so the balance matches the counted cash.
cashier.adjustmentPosted: A reconciliation adjustment was posted to match the counted cash.
cashier.unlockConfirm: Unlock this day? The reconciliation and its adjustment will be removed so it can be redone.
cashier.depositSubtitle: Move cash out of the drawer into a bank account. The drawer balance drops and the deposit shows on the bank statement.
cashier.deleteDepositConfirm: Delete this deposit? Both the drawer and bank entries will be removed.

returns.title: Return Settings
returns.subtitle: Control how early-checkout returns and refunds behave.
returns.draftHint: How to handle not-yet-issued future DRAFT cycles when a guest leaves early.

CANCEL.title: Cancel unissued drafts
CANCEL.desc: Cancel future DRAFT cycles outright (never billed). Issued/paid cycles still get a return credit.

CREDIT.title: Keep draft & credit it
CREDIT.desc: Never touch any invoice — keep the DRAFT and apply a full return credit so it nets to zero.

returns.balanceLabel: How returns affect the balance due
returns.balanceHint: A return never changes the invoice total or line items. This controls how the credit is shown.

NET.title: Balance reflects the credit
NET.desc: The invoice's balance due shows net of return credits (total − paid − credits).

GROSS.title: Keep the gross total visible
GROSS.desc: Show the full total with the credit listed as a separate deduction, then the net due.

returns.rateLabel: Rate used for the returned period
returns.rateHint: Which rate prices the returned nights/cycles. A manual per-return override is always available.

CHARGED.title: Rate the guest was charged
CHARGED.desc: Use the rate stored at booking (handles custom/seasonal rates correctly).

PRICE_LIST.title: Current price list
PRICE_LIST.desc: Re-price the returned period from the unit's current price tables.

problem.title: Sound familiar?
problem.sub: Managing property in a spreadsheet means small mistakes turn into lost money — and long evenings reconciling numbers.

cards.d: Two guests, one unit. You only find out when they’re both at the door.
Who paid, who’s late, who’s on a plan? It lives in your head, not a system.
Rewriting the same invoice every month, then chasing the PDF over WhatsApp.
Contracts here, receipts there. Tax season becomes a treasure hunt.

solution.title: Built for the way you actually work.
solution.sub: Every screen in Binaya maps to a real job a receptionist or manager does every day — nothing you have to translate.

cards.t: See every unit at a glance
cards.d: A live board of every building and unit, colour-coded by status.
Automatic invoices, payment reminders, and plans that track themselves.
Reports that reconcile to the riyal — down to three decimals.

features.title: Never miss a booking again.
features.sub: A calendar that reads like your front desk. Drag to move a booking, tap to check in, and Binaya blocks the dates so you can’t double-book.
bullets: Automatic date blocking — no more clashes
Guest history and notes on every unit

features.title: Track every riyal — to three decimals.
features.sub: Binaya speaks OMR natively. Issue invoices, record payments, and see exactly what’s outstanding — with the precision Omani accounting expects.

features.title: Know your business at a glance.
features.sub: Occupancy, revenue, and outstanding balances on one dashboard. Filter by building, month, or unit — export when you need to.
bullets: Filter by building, month, or unit

features.title: Approve expenses from your phone.
features.sub: Maintenance, utilities, salaries — log an expense with a photo of the receipt and approve it from anywhere. Everything ties back to the right building.
bullets: Snap a receipt, log in seconds
Approve or reject on the go
Assign every expense to a building
See true net income per property

impact.title: Less admin. More managing.
impact.sub: Managers who switch to Binaya spend their time on tenants and buildings — not on chasing numbers.

oman.title: Made in Oman. For Oman.
oman.sub: Binaya isn’t a translated foreign tool. It’s built around how property works here — the currency, the language, and the way you do business.

cards.d: Full right-to-left Arabic and English — switch anytime, nothing breaks.
Baisa-accurate maths built in, not bolted on.
Real people in Oman who know your market — on WhatsApp, in your timezone.

steps.title: From signup to first reservation in three steps.
steps.sub: Most managers are taking bookings within an afternoon.

items.d: Create your account and add your first building — free, no card.
Import or add units, set rates, and invite your team.
Take reservations, send invoices, and get paid.

items.q: We stopped double-booking the week we switched. The calendar alone paid for itself.
Invoicing used to eat my Thursdays. Now it’s done before my coffee.
Finally something in Arabic that works right-to-left. My team stopped complaining.

pricing.title: Start free. Grow when you’re ready.
pricing.sub: One building is free forever. Upgrade only when you add more.

rtl.title: Works beautifully in both languages.
rtl.sub: Every screen mirrors cleanly between English and Arabic — layout, numbers, and all.

items.q: Is it really free for one building?
items.a: Yes — one building is free forever, with unlimited reservations and invoicing. No credit card required.

items.q: Does it work fully in Arabic?
items.a: Completely. Binaya is built right-to-left first. Switch between Arabic and English anytime — every screen mirrors correctly.
Yes. Add as many buildings and units as you need on Pro or Portfolio plans, each with its own reports and expenses.
All amounts are handled to three decimals (baisa), so your totals always reconcile exactly — no rounding surprises.

items.q: Can my team use it too?
items.a: Yes. Invite receptionists and managers with roles and permissions so everyone sees what they need.
You can import units and past bookings, and our team in Oman will help you get set up.

finalcta.title: Run your buildings like a pro.
finalcta.sub: Start free with one building today. No card, no lock-in — just a calmer front desk.
